query: We're starting a new AWS service that ingests IoT telemetry from ~20k devices and alerts on anomalies. I need a system design document. Interview me first, then write it.
help me design the architecture for a customer-deployed CDK solution that scans S3 buckets for PII. need components, NFRs, threat model inputs and a diagram description
i have a vague idea for a document approval workflow service (lambda, step functions probably). can you walk me through the design questions and produce an HLD
Produce a system design doc for our multi-tenant reporting backend. Ask me about scale, compliance (we need SOC2), data stores, observability, then generate the doc plus a design review handoff.
new greenfield project: video transcoding pipeline on AWS. let's do the full design - business context, components, cross cutting concerns, failure modes. focused interview is fine
Can you run me through a structured design session for replacing our cron-based billing job with an event-driven system? End result should be a design doc the team can review.
I need an architecture doc for a chat assistant backend using bedrock, api gateway websockets and dynamodb. challenge my assumptions as we go
write up the high level design for the notification service (email, sms, push) with the threat model input section and architecture diagram description, I'll answer questions
Kick off design for a packaged solution customers will deploy in their own accounts that syncs Okta groups to IAM Identity Center. What do you need to know?
design doc time for our search service rewrite. cover APIs, data design access patterns, deployment and rollback strategy, testing strategy
Quick question: Kafka (MSK) or Kinesis for 2MB/s of clickstream? Just give me your pick and effort estimate.
Write the full STRIDE threat model document for docs/hld.md with mitigations per threat
turn this architecture description into a mermaid diagram
Review the existing design doc docs/design/billing.md and score it for production readiness across all dimensions
design the dynamodb table and GSIs for these access patterns, output CDK code
Explain the saga pattern vs two-phase commit for a blog post I'm writing
prep for my system design interview at a FAANG company next week - quiz me on designing a URL shortener
Break the approved HLD into implementation tasks for two engineers
Write the Smithy IDL for the order service API described in the design doc
extract business context and a requirements summary from the PM's requirements doc for the architect
